messages:
sierra: Giving away a BILLY bookshelf (IKEA, white, 5-shelf) — minor scuff on the back, screws + extra shelf pins included. Also have 2x GA Outside Lands tix (Sat) I can't use. Curbside pickup SoMa or I can drop off near Mission St. DM to claim. Pics: https://imgur.com/xyz789. Free, first-come for both but will split if needed.

noah: dm'd about the bookshelf. can pick up tomorrow evening (6-7pm). do the shelves come assembled or flatpack?

sierra: assembled atm. can take it apart if you prefer — 10-15 min with an allen key.

rita: interested in the tickets only! i'm not in SF that weekend but can accept a Ticketmaster transfer. happy to cover the transfer fee.

sierra: tickets are mobile transfers on TM, that's fine. i'll hold them for you until transfer shows. prefer local pickup for the shelf.

facilities-bot: Reminder: please verify lobby/loading rules before leaving items in common areas. For transfers, use official ticket platforms only.

noah: 6pm works. @sierra ping me the address? i have a hatchback and a friend with a dolly if we need it.

sierra: sending address in DM now. if @rita completes the transfer i'll mark tickets claimed. otherwise it's first-come first-served.

rita: sent confirmation and covered the small transfer fee — thanks! :party_parrot:

olivia: PSA — if anyone's moving furniture 5-7pm, please ping #lobby-coordination so the front desk can reserve space.

sierra: good call, i'll post there. thanks @olivia.

facilities-bot: Logged the pickup event. Note: do not block fire egress or sidewalk. Enjoy the new shelf and shows!
